title: Prestige downtown Nashville suite w pool & parking
description:
Experience Nashville at this modern style suite. This 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom with a modern touch is in the heart of downtown Nashville. This suite is conveniently located only 2 minutes from the iconic Broadway and is surrounded by major attractions, including but not limited to Bridgestone Arena, Country Music Hall of Fame, Nissan Stadium, Music City Center, Museum and more. It's perfect for families, couples and business travelers with many restaurants, bar and shopping walking distance.

The space
This Nashville Suite is designed to give you a high end & comfortable experience. The apartment has a queen bed in bedroom, a convertible sofa & futon in living room,  and a folding bed to allow for comfortable sleeping arrangements. Looking to kick back and stay in a couple days, we got you covered. Take advantage of some streaming with our Roku Smart TV which includes access to  Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, youtube, wifi and more. The kitchen is stocked with cookware if you desire to dine in. In need of some fun? We have a swimming pool with beautiful outdoor sitting and grilling areas available. For those who need to get fit, visit our fitness center. Visit our sky lounge for some quiet study time, work or relaxation. There is a washer and dryer in the unit for your laundry needs. Lastly, the suite is thoroughly cleaned and sanitized immediately after check-out by our partnering company Meme Montheria Cleaning. We also include light cleaning supplies for your peace-of-mind.

Guest access
You have the entire space for 100% privacy for the duration of your stay.
